name: Arugal's Folly
summary: At the Sepulcher, Dalar Dawnweaver sends Forsaken agents to a nearby farmstead for Arugal's earliest spellbooks. The Forsaken need to understand the magic behind the worgen curse if they are to turn it against Arugal and secure Silverpine Forest. The Remedy of Arugal is the first step in unraveling the threat from Shadowfang Keep.

sections.title: A Mage's Derision
sections.body: In the Sepulcher's crypts, ambitious Forsaken mage Dalar Dawnweaver holds Archmage Arugal in contempt. He sees him as an ordinary practitioner whose place in the Kirin Tor makes no sense, and whose grasp of magic seems amateurish. Yet the monstrous beasts roaming Silverpine cannot be ignored. To break Arugal's hold on the region, Dawnweaver means to take apart the spells that unleashed the worgen upon Lordaeron.

sections.title: Remnants on the Farmstead
sections.body: Before claiming Shadowfang Keep, Arugal lived at a secluded wheat farm just north of the river bridge. Deathstalker scouts found discarded spellbooks on the farmhouse's upper floor, but lingering beasts kept them from retrieving the texts. Search the dusty grimoires to uncover the Remedy of Arugal, an incantation that offers crucial insight into the unnatural curse afflicting Silverpine Forest.

faq.answer: Dalar Dawnweaver is an ambitious Forsaken mage in the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest. Dedicated to Sylvanas Windrunner, he seeks to dissect and counter Arugal's magic so the Forsaken can claim the territory.

faq.q: What is the Remedy of Arugal?
faq.answer: The Remedy of Arugal is a spell written in Arugal's discarded books from the time he lived on the farm north of the bridge. Dalar Dawnweaver needs the incantation to study the arcane foundations of Arugal's work.

faq.q: Where are Arugal's old spellbooks located?
faq.answer: Arugal's dusty spellbooks lie on the upper floor of an abandoned farmhouse at the wheat farm just north of the bridge crossing in northern Silverpine.

faq.q: Why does Dawnweaver look down on Arugal?
faq.answer: Dawnweaver considers Arugal an inferior wizard with a shallow grasp of the arcane. He cannot understand why the Kirin Tor accepted Arugal into its ranks in Dalaran.

faq.q: Why is this task important to the Forsaken?
aliases: why do forsaken care about arugal
faq.answer: Arugal's worgen slaughter Forsaken forces and threaten their hold on Silverpine Forest. By studying his spells, the Forsaken hope to stop the threat and secure the region for the Dark Lady.

faq.q: What happens when you touch the dusty spellbooks?
faq.answer: Touching the dusty grimoires alerts a Moonrage worgen hiding in the farmhouse. It attacks anyone who disturbs Arugal's abandoned research.

angles.text: As a Forsaken mage, you can study Arugal's work as a warning of the danger magic brings when wielded without discipline or foresight.
As an undead, you know Silverpine is the western shield of the Undercity. Reclaiming it from feral worgen is vital to securing the Dark Lady's borders.
As a member of the Horde, you face feral beasts contesting your presence in Silverpine. Neutralizing Arugal is vital to establishing stable supply lines out of Lordaeron.
